```{r, warning=F, message=F}


library(dplyr)

source("../../00-constants.R")






# 1.1. Import metadata and protein matrix


# Import data from Box
vap_soma_normalized <- read.csv(
  file.path(raw_data_dir, "vap_soma_normalized.csv"), 
  stringsAsFactors=F
)

metadata_with_mNGS <- read.csv(
  file.path(raw_data_dir, "metadata_JCI_mNGS_hits_added_06122026.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
) %>%
  filter(LRTI_adjudication %in% c("Definite", "No Evidence"))






# 1.2. Log2 Transformation


# Log2 Transformation
prot_cols <- grepl("^seq_", names(vap_soma_normalized))

vap_soma_normalized[, prot_cols] <- log2(vap_soma_normalized[, prot_cols])






# 1.3. Build data frame with all patients


# Identify patients present in both datasets
patients_vector <- intersect(
  vap_soma_normalized$patient_id,
  metadata_with_mNGS$SubjectID
)

# Match JCI metadata to the order of patients in the proteomics dataset
metadata_match <- match(
  vap_soma_normalized$patient_id[
    vap_soma_normalized$patient_id %in% patients_vector],
  metadata_with_mNGS$SubjectID
)

# Produces data frame with patients, age_in_years, sex, LRTI_adjudication, and mNGS hits
metadata_df <- data.frame(
  sample_name = metadata_with_mNGS$sanitized_name[metadata_match],
  sex = metadata_with_mNGS$sex[metadata_match],
  age_in_years = metadata_with_mNGS$age_in_years[metadata_match],
  LRTI_adjudication = metadata_with_mNGS$LRTI_adjudication[metadata_match],
  JCI_virus_1 = metadata_with_mNGS$JCI_virus_1[metadata_match],
  JCI_virus_2 = metadata_with_mNGS$JCI_virus_2[metadata_match],
  JCI_virus_3 = metadata_with_mNGS$JCI_virus_3[metadata_match],
  JCI_BF_1 = metadata_with_mNGS$JCI_BF_1[metadata_match],
  JCI_BF_2 = metadata_with_mNGS$JCI_BF_2[metadata_match],
  stringsAsFactors=F
)

write.csv(
  metadata_df,
  file.path(prot_data_dir, "metadata_df.csv"),
  row.names=F
)




# 1.4. Build protein matrix for all patients


# Isolating Protein Matrix
protein_mat_PROBEID <- as.matrix(
  vap_soma_normalized[
    vap_soma_normalized$patient_id %in% patients_vector,
    prot_cols
  ]
)

# Remove "seq_"
colnames(protein_mat_PROBEID) <- sub("^seq_", "", colnames(protein_mat_PROBEID))

# Replace underscores with hyphens
colnames(protein_mat_PROBEID) <- gsub("_", "-", colnames(protein_mat_PROBEID))

# Sets rownames to patient_id 
rownames(protein_mat_PROBEID) <- metadata_df$sample_name






```
